messages:
nadia.park: Hi team — quick question: Im starting remotely from the UK (offer start 2026-05-01) and need to complete Form I-9. Can a US consulate or UK notary act as our authorized representative for Section 2? Also who covers notary/courier fees?

 tom.peopleops: Good question. I-9 Section 2 needs physical inspection of originals. Options: (1) defer I-9 until youre in US; (2) authorize a rep (notary/consulate) to inspect on our behalf — requires Legal sign-off. If we use a rep, well need their name, title, contact info on the form.

 erin.legal: Employer remains responsible for accuracy even if rep completes Section 2. If you want a rep route, we need: pre-approval, rep statement that they saw originals, scanned Section 2 signed by rep with contact details, and originals/certified copies couriered to People Ops within ~10 business days. Note pandemic flex rules arent blanket practice now. Also flag: working from UK before US arrival may create tax/residency obligations — see Tax team.

 josh.payroll: We can create your payroll record for 2026-05-01 but cannot pay until Section 2 is complete and work auth is verified. Options: keep start date and sign pay-hold ack, or set a US effective hire date when you arrive and run retro pay later.

 carla-onboarding: Checklist if you pursue consulate/notary: upload passport bio page, visa (if any), UK address, and offer letter to the secure portal; arrange consulate/notary who agrees to act as our rep; have them complete Section 2, sign, and upload. Courier originals to SF HR within 10 business days. We reimburse reasonable fees with receipt (cap $75 unless pre-approved). Ill DM a template for the rep wording.

 onboarding-bot: Reminder: do NOT send passport/SSN scans over Slack. Use onboarding.redwood.com/upload.

 nadia.park: Thanks — Ill book a consulate appointment and upload docs. Id like to keep the 2026-05-01 start and will sign the pay-hold ack if required. Please DM the template and reimbursement steps.

 tom.peopleops: Will do. Erin will check tax/residency flags and Carla will DM next steps. Marking thread for follow-up once you have the consulate confirmation. :thumbsup:
